question: In evidence.zip, Use all d99-- members in ZIP central-directory order. Count the nonempty ELF symbol names matching /event_(success|decoy|failure)/.

answer_format.syntax: base-10 integer with no units, separators, whitespace, or explanatory text

oracle_cmd: readelf -W --syms gf_c_events.bin | awk '/Symbol table .\.symtab./{f=1;next} /Symbol table/{f=0} f && $1 ~ /^[0-9]+:$/ && NF>=8 {print $8}' | grep -cE 'event_(success|decoy|failure)'
